Anya (CS): Quick idea024-11-28: lightweight 'rescue nudge' for accounts that go quiet within first 72h after onboarding. Goal: capture enablement feedback and reduce early churn.

Jamal: Where's the signal? CRM field vs event stream? Pilot size?

Anya (CS): Use telemetry `first_successful_login_ts` + `last_meaningful_engagement_ts` gap of 72h. Pilot: ARR >= $5k OR seats >= 10, 10% random sample. Respect `do_not_contact`.

Leo: Engineering notes: write `nudge_sent_at` and `nudge_id` to account record on send to prevent dups. Use dedupe window on events (30m). Need contact-owner mapping for AE escalation.

Priya (Enablement): I'll draft two short variants: 1) checklist + 15-min schedule link; 2) AE outreach template for high-ARR. I'll post copy by EOD.

Playbook Bot: Staging dry run created: run_id=run_rescue_2024_11_28_a. Logs: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/runs/run_rescue_2024_11_28_a

Leo: Backoff/escalation plan: automated at 72h, repeat at 7 days, escalate to AE at day 10. Add `escalated_to_ae` flag. Put feature flag `playbook.rescue_nudge`.

Jamal: I'll emit `last_meaningful_engagement_ts`, `nudge_sent_at`, `nudge_id`, and `suppress_nudges` into the playbook topic tomorrow morning. Will add alert if error rate >1%.

Anya (CS): Action items: Jamal prod fields, Leo add backoff + feature flag, Priya deliver copy. Start 10% pilot in staging today; shadow prod next week. :thumbsup:
